name: INKSIGHTS Knowledge & Control Plane
purpose: Provide one governed retrieval and control layer for founder and AI work without requiring each chat to preload or rediscover the same files.

canonical_boundaries.supabase: Live application/intelligence/operational state and normalized knowledge index.
canonical_boundaries.github: Code, migrations, tests, machine-readable contracts and technical specifications.
canonical_boundaries.google_drive: Human-readable business documents, evidence assets, client deliverables and reusable business templates.
canonical_boundaries.chatgpt: Reasoning and orchestration only; conversation memory is not canonical storage.

retrieval_contract.rule: CURRENT canonical/live evidence outranks INTENDED/PROPOSED material.

future_adapters: hybrid semantic + keyword search once corpus size and query telemetry justify embeddings
